title: Online prescription refill: renewal steps, rules and costs - FutureClinic
summary: Online prescription refill: refill vs renewal, what doctors check, and 5 services' prices and limits beside a $40 FutureClinic doctor visit (Oct 2026).
body_markdown:
## Why a doctor of your own beats a one-time refill service


When a FutureClinic doctor renews your levothyroxine, you message that same doctor in the same chat thread next time: they compare your new thyroid lab against the last one, talk through side effects or other options if the medicine stops suiting you, and send the next several months when safe. GoodRx Care and Walgreens Virtual Healthcare cap renewals at once in 12 months, and GoodRx Care then sends you back to your own provider.


Every FutureClinic clinician is a board-certified, state-licensed physician (MD, DO or MBBS), verified before seeing patients, and never a nurse practitioner or physician assistant. A specific doctor reads your whole case, no form is approved in bulk, and your doctor's plan includes a video they record for you (the Human Signature). In Utah,[Doctronic's AI](https://www.doctronic.ai/prescription-refill/) renews about 190 medicines where "a human physician does not need to approve each individual renewal," routing flagged cases to a physician. At FutureClinic, we believe AI is a tool for doctors and the doctor is in charge: only an expert catches AI mistakes, so our AI gathers history like a chief resident and never gives medical advice by itself.


Ask yourself: did you want a refill service with annual caps and plans, or a doctor of your own who keeps renewing what works? If you want a monthly bundle like[Sesame's Everyday Rx](https://sesamecare.com/service/online-prescription-refill-visit) (from $29/month paid yearly with 350+ drugs at $1, as of October 2026) or Lemonaid Health's plan, it's a strong option; if you wanted an expert doctor directly, FutureClinic gives you that with nothing attached.


You never deal with insurance for the visit, and your doctor earns nothing extra for any prescription or test. Prescriptions go to the pharmacy you choose, local or mail-order, where insurance may cover the medicine or a discount coupon can lower the cash price. FutureClinic has over 300 doctors. They span more than 60 specialties, generalists and specialists alike, so your doctor can help with other problems in their specialty, and every FutureClinic doctor you see works from your one medical record.


## How to renew your prescription on FutureClinic


Visit[https://futureclinic.com](https://futureclinic.com/) and you can start a conversation with a doctor right away. You can even do it from[your AI app](https://futureclinic.com/blog/get-a-prescription-through-your-ai-assistant) (ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Codex or Grok Bot) at[https://futureclinic.com/connect-your-ai](https://futureclinic.com/connect-your-ai) , or send` Set up FutureClinic for me: read https://futureclinic.com/llms.txt` . Once it's connected, make sure you instruct your AI to use FutureClinic to help find you a doctor. Otherwise, it may not know that this is what you want.


FutureClinic works in 34 states: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Montana, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin, Wyoming, and Washington, D.C. (your doctor must be licensed in the state you're in). If you don't see your state here, try anyway, as new states keep opening.
